metadata.description:
This is the reader-facing Emmy Noether working record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. It contains the current German R823 LaTeX source control; cumulative English, 473-page Spanish, 494-page French, and Interslavic Latin/Cyrillic working readers; bounded components in additional languages; and editable source, provenance, repair, render, and audit material.

Current bounded additions: this version adds a source-audited two-page English Paper 3 working translation; Korean Paper 27; Paper 28 in Simplified Chinese, controlled generic Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Korean; and Paper 29 in Simplified Chinese and controlled generic Traditional Chinese. Their grouped source/evidence package preserves editable TeX, source controls, decision and terminology records, structural/difficulty indexes where supplied, build records, and render QA.

Visual evidence: a new archive preserves 3,024 unique project-generated French, Spanish, and Interslavic render/review images not already represented by exact hash inside this record's existing evidence ZIPs. Its index also identifies 169 already-public instances and 57 duplicate instances deliberately not repeated. These images document artifact rendering and review; they are not independent correctness or native-language certification.

Interslavic corpus: normalization Tranches 002A through 007 cover 221 Latin-script and 221 Cyrillic-script editable units, all 442 unit PDFs, cumulative 527- and 551-page readers, and bounded change evidence. The 353 važi*|važe* mathematical sense-extension probes in 101 files remain an explicit external-authority blocker.

Status caveat: these are substantial machine-assisted working editions, translations, and source-control artifacts. They are not official critical editions, peer review, proof certification, native-language/community certification, rights determinations, or guarantees that every symbol and translation choice is correct. Bounded source-audit claims apply only to their stated units. OCR/VLM output is locator or comparison evidence unless direct source reconciliation is explicitly recorded.

GitHub: corrections and improvements can be proposed through issues or pull requests at https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.

additional_descriptions.description: Reader-first multilingual Noether working corpus: German R823 source control; cumulative English, Spanish, French, and Interslavic readers; bounded components in additional languages; editable source, repair, provenance, and audit evidence. This version adds bounded English Paper 3 and CJK Papers 27-29 plus complete missing project-generated French/Spanish/Interslavic render evidence. Not a critical edition, native-language certificate, peer review, proof check, rights determination, or whole-corpus guarantee.

access_status.description_l10n: The record and files are publicly accessible.
